matches.label: Wrocław Główny railway station
matches.notes: Wrocław Główny (Polish for Wrocław main station) is the largest and most important passenger station of the southwestern Polish city of Wrocław. Built in the mid-19th century near the centre of the city, until 1945 it was known as Breslau Hauptbahnhof ("Breslau Main station") (...)

matches.label: Centennial Hall
matches.notes: The Centennial Hall (; formerly Hala Ludowa, People's Hall) is a historic building in Wrocław, Poland. It was constructed according to the plans of architect Max Berg in 1911–1913, when the city was part of the German Empire (...)

matches.label: Wrocław Voivodeship (1975–98)

matches.label: Wrocław Cathedral
